title: Bayangan Di Likot Tahta .
intro: Gata teudong lam halaman saboh keurajeuen jameun nyang teuga, dipat sidroe peunguasa nyang teuga ka geupeugah droe jih sibagoe dewa ateueh banmandum rakyat. Di sampeng penguasa nyoe na sidroe hamba nyang seutia, nyang geubri amanah keu ambisi-ambisi nyang paleng rayeuk lam keurajeuen. Awaknyan meusajan-sajan jipeugot reuncana dan jirencana, hana jitem deungoe peuingat-peuingat sidroe utusan nyang geukirém keu jibimbéng awaknyan. Jeuet gata teupeugah soe hamba nyang seutia nyan?
clues: Lon tinggai lam saboh keurajeuen nyang meukuasa nyang jipeurintah le sidroe tokoh nyang meukuasa nyang jiklaim keutuhanan ateueh mandum rakyat.
Lon meutugaih sibagoe menteri nyang teupeucaya le penguasa nyoe, lon peubuet tiep-tiep ambisi dan peurintah awaknyan.
Watèë sidroë rasul Allah teuka u nanggroë geutanjoë djihôi geutanjoë keu keubeunaran, ulôn dan peunguasa ulôn hana tatem deungoë.
Ulôn geuyue peu-ék apui nyang rayeuk dan geupeusiab batée bata tanoh kliet keu saboh konstruksi nyang rayeuk.
Peunguasa ulôn keuneuk peudong saboh bangunan nyang manyang that sampoe trok u langét keudroe.
Akhé jih ulôn, peunguasa ulôn, tantra-tantra kamoe dan ulôn ka habéh jisampôh dan lhok lam laôt raya.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
